messages:
secops: :warning: Incident: a support bundle sent to an external vendor contained plaintext credentials (env file + two OAuth tokens). Assume compromise and rotate immediately.

maria (support): Bundle ID sb-03-23-462 was uploaded to vendor-buckets/redwood/support/ at 2026-03-23T14:05Z. I removed the object after vendor notified us, but they may have downloaded it. Notified vendor to confirm deletion.

toni (infra): How did .env get included? Our support collector is supposed to scrub dotfiles.

lee (dev): Root cause: a failed migration left .env.backup under /app/tmp and the collector bundles everything under /app unless explicitly excluded. Collector config didn't exclude tmp.

sam (oncall): Quick scans for teams:
```
# search recent bundles for env-like files
aws s3 ls s3://vendor-buckets/redwood/support/ --recursive --human-readable | awk '{print $4, $1}' | rg "sb-03-"
# grep for tokens in unpacked bundles
rg --hidden --no-ignore "(ghp_[A-Za-z0-9_]{36}|xox[baprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-_]{24,})" /tmp/unpacked/* || true
```

legal: We've requested vendor access logs and a written deletion confirmation. If they can't confirm, we'll issue a formal notice. Please preserve chain-of-custody for the bundle.

secops: Action items:
- Immediate: Revoke/rotate any tokens or keys appearing in sb-03-23-462. Treat them as compromised.
- Patch: Update support collector to exclude tmp, dotfiles, and to run a pre-upload secret-scan that blocks uploads.
- Audit: Scan last 90 days of bundles for potential secrets and create a tracker.
- Policy: Halt any future outbound vendor uploads without scrubber approval.

maria (support): I've blocked uploads from CI for the vendor bucket and will retrain support team.

toni (infra): Applied object-level logging and a forensic hold tag 'sec-2332109876'. Rotated infra-owned API keys that matched patterns.

lee (dev): MR #7115 opened: collector now runs an rg-based scrubber and excludes /tmp, /.cache, and dotfiles. Will canary in 30m.

sam (oncall): Started scanning historical bundles; will post hits to SEC-2332109876 thread in Jira.

secops: Deadline: containment + rotations within 48 hours. Post updates here. If vendor reports public exposure prior to deletion, escalate to legal + comms.

legal: Confirmed receipt of vendor logs (partial). Continuing review.

maria (support): Vendor confirms single download (agent@vendor.example.com) and deletion. They provided their access log. Sharing via legal channel.

secops: Thanks. Policy change incoming: support-bundles must pass automated scrubber before any external upload; automation and docs published in 72 hours. Thread open for status updates.
